prompt:
Clean HD painterly 2D game VFX sprite sheet, NOT pixel art, matching the colours and theme of the attached character (Image 1, a young fox-girl swordswoman of fire with a katana). This is ONLY the hit effect of the character's basic attack: no character, no weapon, no hand, no enemy.
Subject: one fast blazing KATANA SLASH: a sharp, thin, bright crescent cut of fire running diagonally from upper-left to lower-right, white-hot edge, golden-orange flame body, crimson flame tongues, embers bursting from the middle of the cut
Layout: EXACTLY 2 columns x 2 rows, four equal square cells, square 1024x1024, read left to right then the next row. The effect keeps the same centre point and scale in every cell, filling about 80% of the cell.
Frame 1: the cut just appearing: a thin white-hot line with sparks at its leading end
Frame 2: the full blazing crescent cut, brightest, a burst of embers at its centre
Frame 3: the cut splitting into flame tongues and flying embers
Frame 4: faint thin trace and drifting embers
Powerful and impactful, opaque painted shapes with crisp edges, no soft haze, no glow halo spreading into the background, no smoke. Keep a magenta margin inside every cell edge; nothing crosses into a neighbouring cell.
Uniform pure flat #FF00FF magenta background, no gradients, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no floor, no shadows.

precheck.summary: The candidate is a 2x2 grid on a flat magenta background, matching the requested layout. Each cell holds one slash-effect frame, and the four frames progress from a thin line to a bright full crescent, then to split flame tongues, then to a faint trace. No effect is cut off by a cell edge, and there is no text, border, or character content. The effects sit roughly centred in each cell, with only minor positional drift, which is acceptable.
